config.data_license: CC BY 4.0 per dataset authors; retain medical narratives and generated text locally
config.generation: float16, batch 1, greedy, do_sample=false, SDPA, seed 42; one generation per record, no repair or prompt tuning based on scores
config.grounding: Require exact evidence substring in full source and term substring in evidence, boolean present, canonical null or one of frozen 24 names; reject malformed items and count them. Reject entire malformed JSON responses. Check generated context truncation separately.
config.evaluation: All 200 records, including failed outputs. Primary: positive canonical concepts against expert Clinical Information projected using frozen symptom dictionary/negation parser, with micro precision/recall/F1, exact set, empty-reference strata, per-concept counts. This is a limited dictionary-projected reference, not full clinical annotation. Secondary strict surface-term comparison to semicolon-split expert information is reported as a diagnostic, not a synonym-aware accuracy estimate. Compare existing rules on same inputs, measure invalid outputs, ungrounded items, token limits and latency. Downstream graph syndrome hit rates on same records are exploratory, using no gold as model input.
limits: These public training records were previously used for exploratory external syndrome evaluation; not an untouched official test
No training or prompt selection on these records
Expert information may omit symptoms; projected labels are incomplete
Grounded quotation does not establish correct medical interpretation
Small local model experiment does not reproduce the original paper's unspecified LLM

model_manifest.verification: Full file SHA256 must match the immutable Hugging Face revision, including when using the author's ModelScope mirror
